origine_fr: 刀 au-dessus de la bouche 口. La bouche appelle, et 刀 donnait le son, mais il se lit dāo, loin de zhào. Appeler les gens : convoquer, réunir.
origine_en: 刀 above the mouth 口. The mouth calls, and 刀 gave the sound, but it reads dāo, far from zhào. Calling people together: to summon, to convene.

phrase.en: The school is holding a meeting tomorrow.
